note: DEMONSTRATION VALUES. Every limit in this file is illustrative, chosen to exercise the pass, breach and unobservable paths across this file on the shipped demo book; no single lens here exercises all three, and the balance lens breaches on every scenario of that book because it runs off fully inside the horizon. None of it is a calibrated or governed limit, and nothing here is any institution's risk appetite. The capital lens ships with one constraint that is always unobservable: no capital metric exists on the result envelope, and a capital component is a later release. The balance lens reads the shipped demonstration custom metric: on a run whose plan named no custom metric stage it reports unobservable with a reason, which is why it can ship without breaking any existing run. The WAL gap lens added in piece 3c reads the second built-in custom metric, `wal-gap`, and reports unobservable the same way on a run that named no `wal-gap` stage; both of its limits are nonzero, so both are fraction basis and either may set the headline.
